limits: C and LLVM share one C provider and OS; no independent OS implementation proof.
Finite deterministic models/fault injection and sanitizers do not establish security or production readiness.
Intermediate source states and every original shell flag are not independently retained; unknown command fields are null. Before/current snapshots and available attempt logs are retained.
No general external FFI, filesystem, external network, TLS, HTTP server, OAuth, static asset embedding or concurrency.
No sustained fuzz campaign or independent security audit.
Per-operation timeouts only; no aggregate wall-clock deadline, revocation or read-only stream capability.
Live research/spec indexes and prior repair path rebind excluded from the historical survey; exclusions are explicit in integrity data.
Failed patch/fixture/oracle/packaging/integrity attempts are not counted as successful red regressions.
The new result is public development evidence; no unseen confirmatory or agent experiment.
